text:
sam: Quick heads-up — aiming to cut coordinated version bumps across API, runtime, console, and SDKs before the Wed cutoff (2026-04-01). Can folks confirm status?

anya: I'm blocked on one console changelog item, will push PR later today. planning semver minor for console (0.5.x -> 0.6.0).

cheng: Runtime PR is up: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/472|#472>. Needs one more perf test + changelog fragment. bump would be 1.12.0 -> 1.13.0 (minor). I can rebase tonight.

maria: SDKs: py and js both need doc updates. py sdk PR draft: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/210|#210>. js has breaking typings fix, will be patch -> 2.4.1.

sam: Thanks. For coordination: plan is -> runtime first (has infra migrations), then API, then console, then SDKs. We should pin compatible runtime tag in API client for the RC.

devex-mgr: Reminder: changelog fragments must be in `changelogs/unreleased/*.md` with the format below. CI will fail if missing.

```
- runtime: improved kv-cache eviction to reduce memory spikes (#472) — cheng
```

anya: will add console fragment now. Also, can we agree on branch names? I'm using `release/bump-console-0.6.0`.

cheng: using `release/runtime/1.13.0`. If anyone needs a hotfix branch we can create `release/hotfix/*`.

maria: SDK branches: `release/sdk-python/2.5.0` (minor), `release/sdk-js/2.4.1` (patch).

sam: CI gating: make sure all PRs have `release/ready` label and pass smoke tests. I'll do the final tag once all PRs merged. Target merge window is Tue 16:00 UTC.

release-bot: Automated status check — runtime: open, api: open, console: open, sdk-python: draft, sdk-js: open. (generated at 1841205000)

anya: pinging @cheng for a quick rebase — console integration tests flake on old runtime API.

cheng: will rebase and run the integration job. ETA 1.5h.

maria: calling out potential breaking change in js typings — added note in PR body and changelog fragment.

devex-mgr: small nudge on changelog style: start with subsystem prefix (runtime/api/console/sdk) and include PR/author.

sam: If we hit blocker during merge window, fallback plan is: postpone SDK bumps by 24h and cut a `rc1` with current compatible versions. Agree?

anya: agree, prefer stable runtime + console pairing.

cheng: agreed. If runtime tests pass I will tag `v1.13.0-rc1` and push.

maria: once rc tag is pushed, I'll open SDK PRs pointing at that tag for compatibility tests.

release-bot: deploy bot: created release checklist issue <https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/issues/89|#89>.

sam: perfect. I'll post final merge checklist here before the window. Thanks all :rocket:

maria: one more ask — please run the compatibility matrix locally with `scripts/compat-check.sh` if you're touching client/server interfaces.

cheng: running it now, will share output if anything odd.

(approx 7 short messages of ack/reactions over the next hour: anya: :thumbsup:, sam: :eyes:, devex-mgr: :white_check_mark:)
